text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: My chest is tight! And it feels hot, like it's on fire!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm shaking and sweating. What's going on with me?
choice_data_list: That sounds like you're taking this seriously.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, so this is what it means to take something seriously… I think I get it now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So it's okay that I feel like this? Then I'll do my best, sweatiness and all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm gonna get first place this time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is going to be a tough race. I'm sure Haru Urara knows that. Just being able to enter is quite a feat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she won't give up. She's not that type of person. So…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The audience's cheers get louder. I'm sure there are quite a few of Haru Urara's fans among them. Fans that believe in her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And… I believe in her too! I'm looking forward to your victory, Haru Urara!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And… I believe in her too! I'm looking forward to your victory, Haru Urara!
